CS-2000A Spectroradiometer (Discontinued)
Click to Enlarge Thumbnails
Click Here to Watch Video
Support for the CS-2000A will be provided until March 2030
View our latest version of this instrument, the CS-3000
The CS-2000A is a highly accurate spectroradiometer with the ability to measure ultra low luminances, as low as 0.0005 cd/m2, and contrast levels of 1,000,000:1. To achieve this, the instrument uses technology to reduce sensor signal noise, a measurement angle of 1°, and by maintaining less than 5nm half bandwidth.
CS-S10w Professional Data Management Software is included as a standard accessory, enabling highly accurate measurement visualization and management. Acceptance judgments based on the dominant wavelength can be completed with this software.
The CS-2000A features a measurement angle switching function which allows the user to select a specified measurement angle of 0.1°, 0.2°, or 1° depending upon the application. This enables a standard minimum measuring diameter of 0.5mm. A close-up lens (optional accessory) can be purchased to measure areas as small as 0.1mm. This enables the instrument to measure general displays and quick and stable luminosity and chromaticity measurements of ultra-small areas such as automotive or aircraft instrument panels and audio systems.

CS-3000 Spectroradiometer
Click to Enlarge Thumbnails
Flexible Measurement Solutions for Advanced Display Evaluation
We design the CS-3000 Spectroradiometers to support a wide range of display measurement applications, from research and development to production and quality control. We provide accurate, stable, and repeatable spectral measurements to help organizations evaluate luminance, chromaticity, and overall display performance.
The series includes models optimized for specific measurement needs.
Versatile Measurement Platform
We designed the CS-3000 Series to accommodate diverse display technologies and workflows, providing reliable performance across multiple use cases.
Spectral Accuracy and Consistency
Our spectroradiometers deliver precise spectral data, enabling accurate evaluation of color and luminance characteristics across display types.
Adaptable to Laboratory and Production Environments
The series supports both development environments and manufacturing lines, helping teams maintain measurement consistency throughout the product lifecycle.
Applications
Display Development We assist engineers in analyzing display characteristics, including color performance, luminance, and uniformity.
Manufacturing and Quality Assurance We help ensure consistent product quality by enabling repeatable measurement processes and clear pass/fail criteria.
Lighting and Visual Performance Evaluation Our solutions support measurement in environments where display performance and lighting conditions interact, ensuring accurate visual assessment.
Why the CS-3000
We provide a measurement platform that combines spectral accuracy, flexibility, and reliability. The CS-3000 Series supports organizations working across a wide range of
display technologies, helping ensure consistent performance from development through production.
